items.title: Amgen Stock And The Price Of A Promise
items.summary: Management raised its full-year forecast, but the market seems to be asking for more than a higher target.

items.title: Is BMY's Growth Portfolio Strong Enough to Offset Legacy Drug Declines?
items.summary: Bristol Myers growth portfolio now accounts for 56% of revenues, led by key drugs, including Opdivo Qvantig, Reblozyl and Breyanzi, helping offset generic erosion.

items.title: Will Pfizer's Non-COVID Portfolio Drive Its Next Phase of Growth?
items.summary: PFE's non-COVID products are gaining momentum, with launches, acquisitions and a pipeline aimed at driving growth from 2029 onward.

items.title: Why Revolution Medicines May Be Big Pharma’s Next Takeover Target
items.summary: RAS mutations fuel nearly a third of all cancers, and one biotech has quietly built the deepest late-stage pipeline targeting them. Now the biggest names in pharma are circling, and the math on who can actually write the check gets complicated fast.

items.title: The S&P 500 Yield Is the Lowest in History: 5 Members of the Legacy Index Yield 6% or More
items.summary: The S&P 500's dividend yield just hit a record low, leaving income investors scrambling for alternatives. Five long-established index members still pay 6% or more, and all carry Buy ratings from top Wall Street analysts.

items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Agreed To A $44 Million Chantix Settlement
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) agreed to a US$44 million class action settlement related to its smoking cessation drug Chantix, addressing claims tied to product safety disclosures. The company reported positive topline Phase 3 results for LITFULO in adults and adolescents with nonsegmental vitiligo, highlighting progress in its immunology pipeline. Both developments arrive as investors track Pfizer's legal exposures alongside late stage trial data that could inform future portfolio and revenue...

items.title: JNJ Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: This healthcare giant is on a serious run, but with the stock trading at a peak, investors must decide if the powerful business engine has more fuel or if the price has already burned it all.

items.title: $49 Billion In Payouts, A Lagging Stock: The PFE Trade-Off
items.summary: Pfizer sent shareholders a fortune in cash, yet the stock fell far behind the market, forcing a hard question about what all that money truly bought.
